question: Does the paper report the performance of the model for each individual language?
title: X-Stance: A Multilingual Multi-Target Dataset for Stance Detection
answer_rationale: Text 6 (page=23) states that Table TABREF36 shows results for the cross-lingual setting, and Text 7 (page=1) mentions the dataset includes German, French, and Italian text, allowing for cross-lingual evaluation. Text 6 also notes that M-Bert performs consistently better than majority class baselines, even in Italian, indicating performance is reported per language.
